g.text: Codex Review - Scope, Execution, Assessment and Recovery
Refresh actual PR base; resolve base/head SHAs
Inspect exact process; do not duplicate
Active runner or possible orphan child?
Read existing assessment or assess pending result
Same base; previous head is ancestor
Main agent must establish bounded fix impact.
Save running state + scope + head + log path
After 15 min: inspect progress / error evidence.
Silence alone is not proof of failure.
No blind retry or automatic timeout pass.
Stream output to terminal and local log
Exit zero AND same head AND clean worktree?
Current runner falls back to full review
when latest saved run is unassessed
Checks original findings + affected test evidence
Verify PR head and required checks before merge
Batch fixes -> affected tests -> applicable redaction
Commit -> push -> select next review scope
Diagnose and rerun with --force-full if needed
